assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, fire safety and engineering constraints require official attachments and professional confirmation.
assumptions.impact: All spatial moves remain conceptual design recommendations rather than statutory or construction controls.

assumptions.statement: SITE-001 and all three key areas are provisional. Repository issue #1029 reports that PROV-KEY-003, labelled Dazhongsi, is spatially located near Beijing North Station.
assumptions.impact: This proposal does not use PROV-KEY-003 to assert station-specific geometry. Dazhongsi station moves are non-spatial concepts until a corrected official polygon is published; every area and intersection must then be recalculated.

assumptions.statement: No verified inventory of benches, drinking water, public toilets, care rooms, shade, charging, staffed help or opening hours is available.
assumptions.impact: The 2/5/15-minute service targets and node counts are design hypotheses. Phase 0 must complete field, accessibility and operating-hours audits before siting.

assumptions.statement: Operating entities, budgets, procurement routes, service-level agreements and data controllers are not confirmed.
assumptions.impact: Phasing names candidate responsibilities only. No government commitment, funding approval or service guarantee is claimed.
